_comment: Triggers are NOT stored here. grade_v2.py derives every content assertion's
applicability from the fixture source at grading time, because a hand-kept
copy of the trigger set is guaranteed to drift from the code it describes.
check_fixtures.py recomputes the same derivation for review.
